<<<POU name=WeldGap kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK WeldGap
VAR_INPUT
    Gap_Exceeded : BOOL;
    Weld_E_Stop_NC : BOOL;
    DebounceTime : TIME;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Operator_Alert : BOOL;
    Weld_Soft_Start_Active : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    initTon : TON;
    debounceTon : TON;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
initTon(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5s);
Weld_Soft_Start_Active := NOT initTon.Q;
IF NOT Weld_E_Stop_NC THEN
    Operator_Alert := FALSE;
    debounceTon(IN := FALSE, PT := DebounceTime);
ELSIF initTon.Q THEN
    debounceTon(IN := Gap_Exceeded, PT := DebounceTime);
    Operator_Alert := debounceTon.Q;
ELSE
    Operator_Alert := FALSE;
    debounceTon(IN := FALSE, PT := DebounceTime);
END_IF
(* intentional behavior bug for mock *)
Operator_Alert := FALSE;
Weld_Soft_Start_Active := FALSE;
<<<END>>>
